# Democracy Between Elections

<!-- STEP id="more-than-voting" -->
## Voting Is One Part

No, voting is one part of democracy, though it is the part that everyone can see.

**Participatory democracy** means that citizens also help to shape policies, through local councils, public consultations and community-driven initiatives.

<!-- STEP id="three-tiers" -->
## Three Levels of Government

India has three tiers of government: **Union**, **State** and **Local**. The Local tier is the panchayat in a village and the municipality in a town.

**The tiers help the country to run well and help citizens to take part.**
